ShortDescription.Value: A better vanilla building menu: sorting, categories, filters and more details.

Publish.LongDescription:
A better version of the vanilla building menu, with sorting, categories and more details. Click any toolbar menu (Roads, Electricity, Education, Zones and the rest) and you get a panel instead of the row of icons.
* Grid, list, cards or table. Category tabs and a search box. * Sort by cost, upkeep, workers, capacity, lot, level or parking. * Group by type, theme, source, density, footprint, cost or progression. * Filter by unlocked, DLC, theme, asset pack, placement, role, source, extensions or density. * Set a range for cost, upkeep, workers, capacity, lot width or lot depth. * Hover an asset to see its numbers and what unlocks it. * Building upgrades get names, cost and footprint too.
The list holds what the menu holds. Trees are under Landscaping; props, decals and hidden assets are not, and there is no object picker. Use Find It for those.
Works with Find It and does not replace it. Find It is a window over every asset in the game; this mod changes the toolbar menus. When Find It's window is open it takes the menu slot; this panel returns when it closes.
No Harmony patches, nothing saved to your city. Remove it any time.
**Options** (Options > Better Building Menu): switch back to the stock icon row; tile size; widen searches to every menu automatically.
Bugs and requests: the comments on this page.
Forked from Find It 1.5.8 by T. D. W. Thanks also to YenYang (UI), Algernon, Chameleon (icons) and Baka-gourd (focus handling).
This mod was developed with AI assistance (Anthropic's Claude), under human direction and review.
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.1.12
Changes * The drag-to-resize edge on the panel shows the game's resize cursor on hover and while dragging, and its grip is drawn at the weight of the game's scrollbar thumb. Hovering it showed no cursor before. * The panel can be dragged down to a single row of cards; before, it stopped at about four rows.
Fixes * In Grid view, a category with room for its tiles in one row no longer stacks some of them into a column. The Cards view had the same rounding error in how a row was spaced.
0.1.11
Fixes * Mods that add their own text no longer each cause a full re-index while the game loads. The index is rebuilt once after the last of them, so a large playset loads without the seconds of stutter per mod. * The Already Built mark on unique buildings and upgrades is drawn at the size of the picture again. Game version 1.6.2 stopped stretching it, so it covered the whole card. * The Upgrades panel has the same drag-to-resize edge as the build menu. Dragging either sets the height for both; a panel with few rows stays short. * In Cards view, a category whose cards wrap onto a second row no longer stretches the first row to double height and hides the cards that wrapped, and a row of cards that fits the category's width stays on one line.
